nodes.name: 0001_initial.py
nodes.summary: Initial Django migration creating the custom User table with all fields including email, role, grade_level, and standard AbstractUser fields.

nodes.name: 0002_add_grade_level.py
nodes.summary: Django migration adding the grade_level field to the User table after the initial schema was created.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the custom User model using email as the primary login field with student and committee roles, grade level, and Satriwit school email domain validation.

nodes.name: UserManager
nodes.summary: Custom manager for the User model providing create_user and create_superuser factory methods with email normalization and password hashing.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Custom AbstractUser subclass that removes the username field, uses email as USERNAME_FIELD, and adds role (student/committee) and grade_level fields with an is_committee() helper method.

nodes.name: tests.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for the accounts app covering user registration, login, logout, role assignment, grade level mapping, email domain validation, and redirect security.

nodes.name: _post_register
nodes.summary: Module-level helper that POSTs a registration form to the register URL with default valid data and accepts keyword overrides for individual field testing.

nodes.name: RegisterTest
nodes.summary: TestCase covering all registration paths including successful student and committee registration, grade level assignment, email domain enforcement, duplicate detection, and password mismatch rejection.

nodes.name: LoginTest
nodes.summary: TestCase verifying login with correct/incorrect credentials, unknown emails, authenticated-user redirect, and safe versus unsafe next-parameter redirect handling.

nodes.name: LogoutTest
nodes.summary: TestCase confirming that POST to logout redirects to the login page and GET to logout redirects to the dashboard.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS entry point for the Next.js frontend, importing Tailwind CSS directives and defining base custom properties.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Root Next.js layout component that wraps all pages with the Navbar, applies Geist font, and sets HTML lang and metadata for the school portal frontend.

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Default export React component that provides the HTML shell, applies Geist Sans and Mono fonts, and renders the Navbar above the page children.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Homepage component for the Next.js frontend serving as the landing page for the Satriwit school portal with links to portal features.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.summary: Default export React component rendering the portal landing page with hero section and navigation links to news, competitions, and study notes.

nodes.name: navbar.tsx
nodes.summary: Responsive navigation bar component with mobile hamburger menu, scroll-aware styling, and links to all portal sections for the Next.js frontend.

nodes.name: Navbar
nodes.summary: Default export client component using three useState hooks to manage mobile menu open state, scroll position, and active link, rendering a full navigation bar with responsive mobile drawer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses 'use client' directive for React 19 / Next.js App Router client-side interactivity with useState hooks.
